tuweb.faq.title: Clear your doubts before deciding
tuweb.faq.q1: Can the site include a rate calculator, shopping cart or blog?
tuweb.faq.a1: These types of features require business logic, thorough testing and, in many cases, periodic data updates. That implies a level of development and maintenance complexity different from an informative landing page. The recommended strategy is to launch the landing page first to establish digital presence and capture inquiries. Once operational, we evaluate together whether it makes sense to tackle those tools as an independent project in a second phase.
tuweb.faq.q2: My production capacity is limited. Wouldn't a website bring more demand than I can handle?
tuweb.faq.a2: A professional digital presence doesn't necessarily mean more volume of work, but rather better quality clients. The landing page elevates the perceived value of your service, attracting clients with higher willingness to pay for quality. You can also communicate your schedule availability directly on the site, allowing you to manage expectations and maintain control over your production capacity.
tuweb.faq.q3: If I put prices on the website, competitors will see them and I lose flexibility to charge per project.
tuweb.faq.a3: You decide whether to show prices or not. In custom services, many clients prefer not to publish them to maintain flexibility when quoting and avoid exposing their cost structure. The landing page adapts to your criteria: if you want to show reference rates, we include them. If you'd rather not publish them, the site highlights the quality of your work, explains your methodology, and directs the quote request to a direct channel. It's your strategic choice, not a technical limitation.
tuweb.faq.q4: I already have a presence on Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp. What does a website offer that social media doesn't?
tuweb.faq.a4: Social media is an excellent outreach channel, but it operates in an environment you don't control: content has short visibility, you compete with multiple stimuli on the same screen, and search engines don't index posts. A landing page with your own domain is a permanent digital asset that projects professionalism, appears in Google searches, and centralizes your business information without distractions. Both channels complement each other: social media attracts traffic, the landing page converts.
tuweb.faq.q5: What happens if I want to make changes after the site is delivered?
tuweb.faq.a5: The service includes minor adjustments and modifications at no cost during the first year, such as text, image, color or link changes. If you require new features or a structural redesign, we discuss it, evaluate the scope, and I provide a separate quote before starting.
tuweb.faq.q6: Can I sell my products through the site?
tuweb.faq.a6: Yes, we can develop a section so you can sell your products. The flow does not include a shopping cart or payment gateways: the client selects the products and quantities they want, and upon confirmation the order details are sent to your WhatsApp as a message. This way you can confirm product availability and adjust actual costs on a case-by-case basis. This mechanism lets you sell without losing control of the negotiation.
